WITH exec_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ordersmark, '__MISSING__') as ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, '__MISSING__')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    exec_count,
    exec_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions) as share
  FROM exec_groups
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    exec_count,
    share,
    share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) as difference
  FROM shares
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    exec_count,
    share,
    difference,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) as rnk
  FROM with_diff
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  exec_count,
  share,
  difference,
  rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY difference DESC, CASE WHEN ordersmark = '__MISSING__' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC    -- ranks by difference alone; ties share same rank; includes all rank ≤10 including ties at 10; sorts result by difference desc, nulls last; no rounding
